summary: Phase 4 backend testing: 25/25 tests pass in test_phase4_backend.py + 47/48 (1 expected skip) in phase 1+2 regression. Every Phase 4 feature is fully functional: (1) POST /api/projects/scenes starts generation (200) and rejects duplicates within 10 min with HTTP 409. (2) Scene images now live on filesystem at /app/backend/media/scenes/{pid}/scene_N.png with image_url + image_path; Mongo project doc no longer contains image_data_url base64 for scenes. (3) GET /api/media/scenes/{pid}/{file} authenticates via Bearer header AND ?token= query param, returns image/png, 401 unauth, 404 for missing file / non-owned project. (4) GET /api/trends?source=reddit&niche=horror returns a consistent structure (falls back gracefully when cloud IP is blocked). (5) /trends?source=youtube without OAuth falls back cleanly. (6) POST /api/agent/run returns <5s with {project_id, status:running, stage:queued} and GET /api/agent/status/{id} exposes full contract and stage progression. (7) GET /api/calendar returns {items, today} with per-item fields and chronological sort. All Phase 1/2 regression endpoints (auth, projects, voices, script, voice, thumbnail, render, publish-fallback, billing, youtube auth-url, analytics, series) remain green. Phase 3 scenes persistence now works end-to-end (previous iteration's CRITICAL missing endpoint is resolved).

minor.issue: Returned auth URL contains client_id= (empty) in the query string even though GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID is set in backend/.env. Real OAuth will fail. Likely youtube_service reads os.environ at import-time before load_dotenv, or uses a different env key. Test still passes because the URL host is accounts.google.com, but the actual OAuth handshake cannot succeed. Low urgency only because YT OAuth isn't required for phase 4 tests, but blocks real publishing.

Reddit returns static-seed fallback from cloud IP (expected per agent context). No-op for correctness but users won't see real Reddit titles until traffic originates from a non-blocked IP or auth flow is added.

Full background pipeline (script→voice→thumbnail→scenes→render→publish) is unmonitored once launched; if it fails mid-stage (e.g., OpenAI rate-limit), error is stored but no retry/backoff. Acceptable for MVP; consider idempotent resumption.

action_items: (Low) Fix youtube_service auth URL to populate client_id from GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID. Currently returns `client_id=` empty. Likely env read timing; ensure load_dotenv runs before youtube_service imports or read env inside auth_url().
(Optional) Consider splitting server.py (1496 lines) into routers (auth, projects, pipeline, agent, billing, youtube, media) for maintainability.
(Optional) Add progress telemetry / retry in _agent_run_background so a transient OpenAI failure does not permanently mark the run errored.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1496 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline. Strong recommendation to modularize into APIRouter files.
_agent_run_background reads proj['duration_seconds'] and builds an LlmChat per stage; no retry. Any transient 429/5xx kills the whole pipeline.
_generate_scenes_background runs serially (not asyncio.gather). 6 scenes × ~20s = 2 min wasted wall-time vs parallel. Consider gather with semaphore.

serve_media sets security=Depends(security) but HTTPBearer auto_error is default (True elsewhere) — here it’s safely Optional. Confirm HTTPBearer(auto_error=False) to avoid unintended 403s when no header present before the token= fallback runs.
storage_service.save_scene_image overwrites scene_N.png on retry without version suffix — fine today but no audit trail.
/api/calendar fetches up to 500 projects in one shot without pagination; future scale concern.
youtube auth-url client_id is empty in issued URL (minor bug above).

success_rate.backend: 100% phase4 (25/25) + 98% phase1+2 regression (47/48, 1 expected ElevenLabs skip)

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed projects (phase4, agent). Scene PNGs persist at /app/backend/media/scenes/{pid}/. One agent run triggers full pipeline in background (~3-5 min); project remains in DB after test completes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run all: cd /app/backend && pytest tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Phase 4 file is tests/test_phase4_backend.py (25 tests, ~200s). Note: TestScenesFilesystem creates a fresh project + full scene generation (~60-120s for image gen). Idempotency test relies on the first POST still being 'generating' when the second POST fires — runs instantly in same fixture so reliable. TestMediaAuth reuses an existing project with scene files via a fixture that scans /app/backend/media/scenes. Agent test only polls 6×10s = 60s, so pipeline may still be running at test end (expected). If YouTube auth-url test fails again, main agent needs to fix client_id env read in youtube_service.
rca of the issue: N/A — no unresolved critical issue. The Phase 3 CRITICAL (missing POST /projects/scenes) has been implemented and verified end-to-end in Phase 4, including filesystem persistence and 10-min idempotency window.
